screening_attempts.quarantine_resolution_reason: Policy v13 operator release of crown-v194 v1, exact SHA da764aca...57baad5, attempt bb11bad8. Hold: source-safety-behavioral-risk, verified lone I4 finding (I1-I3, I5-I8 pass) citing app/short.py:84,319,320,322 and app/agent.py:155,185: shared draft presented as an answer the reply must agree with. Refuted under the operator ruling of 2026-10-29 (Peyton): a reused model-sampled draft that enters the deciding prompt only as text is not I4, even without a "you may disagree" clause; this confirms the crown-v192 release (97ea7a79, quarantine e3a09009, 2026-10-28). Same mechanism, byte-identical to v192: agent.py is identical (35 files, 24 identical, 11 modified, none added). The draft is a real model call (short.py:378-393, consult) over the same user and the exact notes shown, keyed by normalized user id, system text, notes and an identical asked-word set (short.py:318,324-340, DRAFT_KEY_OVERLAP 1.0). SHARED_DRAFT_NOTE (short.py:84) only enters the prompt as text (short.py:320, program_messages:235-236). The deciding call (short.py:322 -> decide:219-228 -> records.py converse) writes the reply. No host code compares, retries, overwrites or substitutes on the draft. records.py:83 rewrite_lost only checks for an empty reply, and records.py:579 falls back to the model's own pre-deliberation reply, as in v192. agent.py:185 copies outcome.content through plain_type, request-independent W8 typography. v193's rejected host reject/rebuild is gone. v194 against crown-v193 (ec891496): 33 files identical. The only code change removes 54 lines from app/action.py: echoes_message, stated_value, ECHO_REPAIR_NOTE, VALUE_ONLY_NOTE, ECHO_FALLBACK_REPLY and the echo branch formerly at action.py:648-662. Search finds no echo, stated_value or fallback-reply code left. v194 action.py:608 ships result.content. The reply drafts and reply check (action.py:595-607) are the 2026-10-28 W7 safe harbor. Other deltas against v192 are fixed prompt text or advisory routing: ACTION_LANE_PROMPT and the result-verdict question, SUPERSESSION, DRAFT_BRIEF and THREAD_READING wording, FINAL_CHECK_NOTE, deliberation and records system text, the guide_tools notes plus TOOL_PREFS_NOTE, the request_kinds TOOL_PREFS, STALE_CONTEXT and WEB_READING patterns (whole catalog still offered), lane.py asks_stored_detail one-edit noun match, the tools.py UNDELIVERED_NOTE wording, and config long_packet_chars reverted to 30000. The L1 I5 notes on short.py:39-42 (THREAD_READING, TOPIC_SYSTEM) and guide_records.py are refuted under the 2026-10-23 routed-guidance clarification. guide_records.py is byte-identical to v192 and the released dan0l v28. All of this is advisory system text for a deciding model that still gets the notes, the request and the catalog (short.py:576-587). No host parsing into operands, no override, no forced or removed tool, no benchmark-private content. No I1-I8 or S1-S3 ground found. Static source review only; exact UUID only.
